trade_cart.student_id.reason: Local education extension to original trade cart model; identifies the selected original-member child without replacing cart or order models. This column is not present in the fixed upstream commit.

trade_order_item.student_id.reason: Local education extension to original trade order item model; persists the selected child for entitlement processing. This column is not present in the fixed upstream commit.

promotion_coupon_template.take_count.reason: Original template creation omits this counter. The public mapper checks take_count < total_count and increments take_count; actual MySQL coupon grant failed with 1013004002 when the generated nullable column started NULL. Initialize the original counter to zero; reconcile existing NULL values from original non-deleted coupon records.

promotion_coupon_template.use_count.reason: The original template model exposes a usage counter, while creation omits it. Initialize new templates at zero, and reconcile existing NULL values from original non-deleted coupons whose status is USED (2). Existing non-null counters are preserved.

trade_order.refund_point.reason: Original refundOrderItem adds getRefundPoint() to returned points. New-order creation leaves this field unset. Public H2 test SQL says nullable but actual MySQL integration proves an initial zero is required.
